datasets.title: LncRNA RVRL1 restricts rabies virus infection by disrupting PRC2 complex [RNA-seq]
datasets.summary: Rabies is an ancient infectious disease but still lacking efficient therapeutic approach despite of vaccine. In this study, we have identified a novel cytoplasmic lncRNA, namely rabies virus related lncRNA 1(RVRL1), whose expression in neuronal cells is up-regulated upon the infection of the causative agent of rabies, the neurotropic virus rabies virus (RABV). RVRL1 effectively inhibits RABV infection both in neuronal cells and in a mouse model. RVRL1 binds to EZH2 and disrupts the PRC2 complex, which is consistent with the inverse relationship between RVRL1 expression and the cellular H3K27me3 level. RVRL1 expression positively regulates the expression of PCP4L1 encoding a 10 kD peptide, which is shown to inhibit RABV replication. These findings highlight a novel mechanism for lncRNAs to upregulate the expression of antiviral genes, and define two potential anti-rabies reagents including an antiviral lncRNA and an antiviral peptide.
datasets.overall_design: Neuron cell and tissue mRNA profile of three time points after RABV infection,and control samples were generated by deep sequencing, in triplicate.  Neuron cell mRNA profile of two time points after RABV infection and RVRL1+/- were generated by deep sequencing, in duplicate.
datasets.study_design: 小鼠N2a细胞及脑组织RABV感染时间序列与RVRL1过表达，RNA-seq分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 研究RABV感染小鼠神经元的 lncRNA 抗病毒机制

evidence.relevant: 研究主体为狂犬病毒感染及宿主抗病毒机制，样本为RABV感染的小鼠脑组织和神经元细胞系，两者均直接围绕狂犬病致病过程。
evidence.sequencing_type: molecule=polyA RNA，明确polyA富集mRNA；library_strategy=RNA-Seq，bulk水平，典型mRNA表达谱
evidence.survival_analysis: 全部样本为小鼠/细胞系，无患者生存时间与状态字段
evidence.treatment: 核心比较轴是感染状态和RVRL1水平，无药物干预
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 组织样本均为RABV感染脑组织(stage:0d/2d/4d/6d)，无未感染健康脑组织对照；细胞系(N2a)为体外实验(P5)。缺失对照组臂，不满足两臂共存。因此翻false。
evidence.correlation: 动物模型感染组织不计入独立患者数，无足够疾病样本做相关性
evidence.sample_source: GSE含两批材料：①29个GSM source='N2a cell line'(小鼠神经母细胞瘤细胞系)，属已建系体外培养→cell_line；②21个GSM source='brain tissue'(RABV感染小鼠脑组织直接取材测序)，未分选特定细胞类型→tissue。两批独立去重合并。

datasets.title: Gene Expression Analysis of Host Innate Immune Responses in the Brain and Spinal cord following Lethal CVS-11 Infection in Mice
datasets.summary: The microarray and advanced pathway analysis of mice caused a paralysis in a fatal infection of a highly pathogenic CVS-11 was performed for the understanding of the detail gene networks and biological functions of inflammatory response and the related genes of innate immunity and apoptosis.
datasets.overall_design: Spinalcord Samples: Six female C57BL/6J mice aged six weeks old were inoculated 1E+7 focus-forming units (FFU) of CVS-11 propagated in MNA cells into the left hind limb, intramuscularly. On the other hand, MEM was inoculated into 6 negative control mice in a similar way. Each mice were sacrificed to collect their spinal cords at days 7 postinoculation (dpi). Six mice were used for the analysis of microarray. The six of mock mice were also sacrificed at 7 dpi for the microarray analysis.
datasets.study_design: C57BL/6J小鼠感染狂犬病毒CVS-11后7天脑与脊髓组织，与mock对照进行表达芯片分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用狂犬病毒CVS-11感染小鼠脑与脊髓模型

datasets.title: Genome-wide identification and analysis of gene expression in brains of mice infected with FJDRV, a street rabies virus with high virulence, and ERA, a laboratory-adapted virus with lower virulence
datasets._0970ed: SOGEN·索臻·标注这道工序我们替你做了·增量更新加群·公众号光热生物/科研风向标/组学料理
datasets.summary: Host-virus interaction was analyzed at gene expression level. The hypothesis tested in the present study was that rabies virus (RABV) infection affects the gene expression in brains of mice and RAB with different virulence induce distinct expression pattern in host. Results provide important information that RABV infection led to alteration of gene expression in brains of mice and FJDRV, a street rabies virus with highly virulence isolated from brain of rabid dog in Fujian provice of China, or ERA, a laboratory-adapted rabies virus with lower virulence induced different expression pattern, including immune-related and cellular signaling-related genes.
datasets.overall_design: An eighteen chip study was performed using total RNA isolated from brains in Treatment 1, three BALB/c mice infected with FJDRV, Treatment 2, three BALB/c mice infected with ERA, and Control, three BALB/c mice non-infected and all treatments were performed with two technical replicates.

datasets.title: Transcriptome Analysis of Rabies virus-infected Mice Salivary Glands
datasets.summary: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease posing a threat to the public health globally. Rabies virus (RABV) is excreted in the saliva of infected animals, and is primarily transmitted through bite contact. Salivary glands play an important role for virus propagation. However, the significance of salivary glands is less studied in RABV pathogenic mechanisms. To identify functionally important genes in the salivary glands, we employed RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) to establish and analyze mRNA expression profiles in parotid tissue infected with two RABV strains, CVS-11 and PB4. We map the transcriptome changes in response to RABV infection in parotid tissue for the first time. This work provides new clues to the study of RABV-affected salivary gland function and RABV transmission mechanisms in parotid tissue. And the salivary gland-enriched transcripts could be potential targets of interest for rabies disease control.
datasets.overall_design: 36 mice were assigned to three groups (mock, CVS-11- and PB4-infected groups), each group contained 12 mice. Within each group, 4 mice constituted one biological replicate. We employed RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) to establish and analyze mRNA expression profiles in uninfected mice parotid tissue (mock group) and parotid tissue infected with two RABV strains, CVS-11 and PB4.

datasets.title: Transcriptome of RABV infected mouse brain
datasets.summary: Here we show the transcriptome of brain from RABV infected B6 mice and TLR7 KO mice. These differential transcripts will provide a reference for studies focus on the relationship between TLR7-dependent signaling and pathogenicity of RABV.
datasets.overall_design: B6 mice were infected with RABV and RNA from brain were collected at 6 day p.i. Rabies virus strain B2c is a lab-attenuated rabies virus strain.
datasets.study_design: B6小鼠(WT与TLR7 KO)脑组织，感染RABV与未感染对照的转录组比较
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用狂犬病毒感染的小鼠脑组织转录组研究致病机制

evidence.relevant: 研究RABV感染脑的转录组与TLR7依赖性致病机制，样本为狂犬病模型脑组织，直接研究狂犬病。
evidence.sequencing_type: 常规转录组测序，Trizol提取总RNA，cDNA文库，无特定非编码RNA富集，默认判mRNA-seq
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为小鼠，非人类患者，无生存随访字段
evidence.treatment: 干预为RABV感染，非药物治疗，无药物对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 平台为RNA-seq，但感染vs未感染样本量最大仅2v2，不满足≥3v3
evidence.correlation: 小鼠模型样本非疾病患者，且仅4例，无法满足≥16例患者的相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有4个GSM均直接从小鼠脑组织取材提取总RNA测序，未进行细胞分选或体外培养，属于整体实体组织直接测序。
